bids.entity: Collier County BCC (Public Utilities + Parks & Rec)
bids.title: Countywide Chemicals
products: pool chemicals: NaOCl, sodium bicarbonate, muriatic acid, calcium chloride, cal-hypo, soda ash, chlorine tablets
bids.quantities: 29 line items; annual estimates from ~3,000 lb (sludge polymer) to ~8,000,000 lb NaOH (Exhibit Q / J2); bid schedule priced per unit
bids.delivery: FOB destination, all-inclusive unit price (tariffs, duties, fuel – no surcharges); 2 regional WTPs, 2 regional + 2 subregional WWTPs, 5-6 aquatic venues; order processing 5 business days; 6-hr emergency on-site response
bids.contract_term: 4 years + one 1-year renewal; prices firm 1st year; primary/secondary/tertiary award per line item
bids.bonds: Per Insurance & Bonding Req. v4: bid bond 5% and 100% P&P bonds stated for awards >$200k (verify in Exhibit K)
bids.insurance: Collier Insurance Requirements Version 4 FE (COI within 5 days of Notice of Recommended Award)
bids.standards: AWWA standards + NSF/ANSI 60 where applicable; COA every delivery; SDS
bids.local_preference: Yes – Collier County local vendor preference (Form 4, Procurement Ordinance Sec. 16)
bids.other_requirements: E-Verify enrollment at submission; FL Dept of State registration
bids.submission: Electronic only – OpenGov Procurement portal (free account)
bids.fit: HIGH – home state, line-item award, many commodity items (NaOCl, caustic, cal-hypo, soda ash, pool chems)
